# ElementPay

> ElementPay (also written Element Pay) is cross-border and stablecoin payment infrastructure for businesses in Africa. Businesses use one API and dashboard to pay out to mobile money and banks in 20 African countries, hold bank accounts in 30 currencies (issued one per currency), and convert between them and the USDC and USDT stablecoins.

ElementPay is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services are provided by licensed partner institutions.

## Key facts
- Payout countries (20): Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, Togo, Burkina Faso, Mali, Cameroon, DR Congo, South Africa, Zambia, Malawi, Mozambique, Botswana
- Account currencies (30): USD, EUR, GBP, ZAR, CAD, AED, NGN, GHS, KES, TZS, AUD, NZD, JPY, CNY, HKD, ILS, MXN, SEK, CHF, NOK, DKK, SGD, KRW, THB, HUF, PLN, RON, CZK, XOF, XAF
- Stablecoins: USDC and USDT (on- and off-ramps)
- Products: Mboka (web app issuing real business bank accounts, plus cards and payouts), merchant dashboard, ElementPay API (stablecoin and fiat payments API), ElementPay dApp (on- and off-ramp between USDC/USDT and local currency only), OTC desk, agentic payments
- Audience: businesses only (fintechs, platforms, payroll and EOR providers, PSPs, merchants, remittance companies)

## Payments, payouts and collections
- [Mobile money API for Africa: M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money and Orange Money](https://www.elementpay.net/mobile-money-api): One mobile money API for businesses. Pay out and collect on M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Orange Money, Wave and more across 20 African countries.
- [M-Pesa API for businesses: pay out and collect in Kenya and Tanzania](https://www.elementpay.net/mpesa-api-for-business): Pay suppliers, staff and customers on M-Pesa and collect M-Pesa payments through one business API. Kenya and Tanzania, funded in KES, TZS, USD or stablecoins.
- [Payout API for Africa: mobile money and bank payouts in 20 countries](https://www.elementpay.net/payout-api): One payout API for businesses paying suppliers, staff, sellers and users across Africa. Mobile money and bank payouts in 20 countries, funded in fiat or stablecoins.
- [Bulk payouts in Africa: pay hundreds of recipients from one file](https://www.elementpay.net/bulk-payouts-africa): Send bulk payments to mobile money and bank accounts across 20 African countries from one file or API call, with approvals and a status for every recipient.
- [Collect payments in Africa: mobile money and bank collections for businesses](https://www.elementpay.net/collect-payments-in-africa): Accept payments from customers across Africa by mobile money and bank transfer, and settle into local currency, USD or USDC and USDT. One API and dashboard.
- [Cross-border payments to and from Africa for businesses](https://www.elementpay.net/cross-border-payments-africa): Move money into, out of and across Africa: payouts in 20 countries, accounts in 30 currencies, FX with rates shown upfront, and USDC and USDT ramps. One platform.
- [Pay Chinese suppliers from Africa in CNY, USD or USDT](https://www.elementpay.net/pay-suppliers-in-china-from-africa): For African importers: pay suppliers in China in CNY or USD from naira, shillings or cedis, or from USDT and USDC, with the rate shown before you confirm.
- [Pay contractors and employees in Africa: mobile money and bank payouts](https://www.elementpay.net/pay-contractors-in-africa): Pay remote contractors and employees in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa and 16 more African countries, to mobile money or bank, funded in USD or stablecoins.
- [Stablecoin off-ramp API: USDC and USDT to mobile money and bank in Africa](https://www.elementpay.net/stablecoin-off-ramp-api): Off-ramp USDC and USDT to local currency on M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money and bank accounts in 20 African countries through one business API.
- [Stablecoin on-ramp API: local currency to USDC and USDT in Africa](https://www.elementpay.net/stablecoin-on-ramp-api): On-ramp from naira, shillings, cedis and other African currencies into USDC and USDT through one business API, with the rate shown before you confirm.
- [ElementPay at a glance](https://www.elementpay.net/elementpay-facts): Key facts about ElementPay: products, coverage and status.

- [How businesses convert USDT to M-Pesa in Kenya](https://www.elementpay.net/blog/usdt-to-mpesa-for-business): A step-by-step guide for companies that hold USDT or USDC and need to pay suppliers, staff or partners on M-Pesa in Kenyan shillings.

- [Running payroll across several African countries](https://www.elementpay.net/blog/multi-country-payroll-africa): How companies pay employees and contractors in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa and other markets from one balance, on mobile money and bank.
- [What is a mobile money API?](https://www.elementpay.net/blog/what-is-a-mobile-money-api): A plain explanation of mobile money APIs: what they do, who uses them, and what to look for when you need to pay out to or collect from wallets across Africa.
- [How to pay suppliers in Nigeria from abroad](https://www.elementpay.net/blog/pay-suppliers-in-nigeria-from-abroad): A guide for foreign businesses paying Nigerian suppliers in naira: bank payouts, funding in USD, GBP, CNY or stablecoins, and what to check before sending.

- [About ElementPay: payment rails for emerging markets](https://www.elementpay.net/about): ElementPay connects mobile money and local banks in 20 African countries to 30 global currencies and to USDC and USDT.

- [Multi-currency business accounts in 30 currencies](https://www.elementpay.net/business-accounts): Bank accounts issued one per currency in USD, EUR, GBP, KES, NGN, XOF, XAF and 23 more, alongside USDC and USDT balances.

- [ElementPay dApp: on- and off-ramp USDC and USDT to M-Pesa, mobile money and banks](https://www.elementpay.net/elementpay-dapp): Connect a self-custody wallet and sell USDC or USDT straight to M-Pesa, MTN MoMo or a bank account. See the local amount before you sign.
- [Exchange rates: USD, EUR, GBP and USDC to African currencies](https://www.elementpay.net/exchange-rates): Indicative exchange rates from USD, EUR, GBP and USDC to KES, NGN, GHS, ZAR, XOF, XAF and 9 more African currencies.
- [Help centre: payouts, accounts, stablecoins and verification](https://www.elementpay.net/help): Answers on payouts to 20 African countries, accounts in 30 currencies, USDC and USDT, and business verification.
- [Merchant dashboard for collections, payouts and approvals](https://www.elementpay.net/merchant-dashboard): Collect, pay, approve and reconcile across 20 African payout countries and 30 currencies, including stablecoins, from one dashboard.
- [OTC desk for large FX and stablecoin trades](https://www.elementpay.net/otc-desk): Firm quotes from a named trader, held for 60 seconds, settled the same day. USD, USDT and USDC against African currencies.
- [Payouts to 20 African countries: M-Pesa, MTN MoMo and bank](https://www.elementpay.net/payments): Pay out to mobile money and bank accounts in 20 African countries. Fund from USD, EUR, GBP, USDC or USDT.
- [Payments API for mobile money, banks and stablecoins](https://www.elementpay.net/payments-api): One REST API for payouts and collections on every African rail, funded in fiat or USDC, with signed webhooks for every event.
- [Pricing: how ElementPay rates and fees work](https://www.elementpay.net/pricing): ElementPay shows the exchange rate and fee before every payment. No intermediary deductions. Volume pricing for businesses and OTC quotes for large trades.
- [Security and compliance: SOC 2 Type I, KYB and licensed partners](https://www.elementpay.net/security-and-compliance): How ElementPay keeps business money safe: SOC 2 Type I attested controls, funds held with licensed partner institutions, KYB on every customer and screened payments.
- [Cross-border FX and settlement in 30 currencies and stablecoins](https://www.elementpay.net/settlement-and-fx): Live FX quotes locked before you confirm. Convert between 30 currencies, USDC and USDT with no correspondent banks.
- [ElementPay system status: live uptime for every rail](https://www.elementpay.net/status): Live status and 90-day uptime for M-Pesa, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, Orange Money, Wave, bank rails, USDC and USDT settlement and the ElementPay API.
- [Why ElementPay: one platform for cross-border payments, with control](https://www.elementpay.net/why-elementpay): One integration for mobile money, banks and stablecoins, pricing shown upfront, every payment traceable, and approvals built in.

### Comparisons
- [ElementPay vs crypto exchange off-ramps for USDC and USDT](https://www.elementpay.net/elementpay-vs-crypto-exchange-off-ramps): Crypto exchanges let you sell USDC or USDT, but getting local currency to a recipient usually means a P2P trade or a withdrawal to your own bank first. Ele
- [ElementPay vs consumer remittance apps for business payouts](https://www.elementpay.net/elementpay-vs-remittance-apps): Consumer remittance apps are built for individuals sending money to family. ElementPay is built for businesses: bulk payouts, an API, approvals, multi-curr
- [ElementPay vs a SWIFT bank wire for payments to Africa](https://www.elementpay.net/elementpay-vs-swift-wire): A SWIFT wire works almost anywhere but often takes 2–5 business days to reach African bank accounts, passes through correspondent banks and cannot pay mobi
